name: smwpatches-ram-specific-l-r-scroll-disable
title: RAM Specific L/R Scroll Disable
description:
Disables L/R Scrolling if the freeram address you specify is not equal to zero. Works midlevel too, and you can constantly flip this status if you want.

Note: if you just want to disable L/R scroll in the entire game, use the hex edit at $00CDF6 instead.
